The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-08-shangyu-006-liu-annotation-002) further confirms '戎爲兒童', linking 戎 to the child visitor. The courtesy-name-to-person mapping is well-established and directly supported by the source text.

Zhong Hui hopes that at that future time (twenty years hence) there will be no talent left stranded in the realm.
Liu Xiaobiao's annotation notes that Zhong Hui found them remarkable and that Wang Rong was still a child at the time.
